name: whatsapp_closure_preferences
description: Most recent ticket activity notice consent per WhatsApp sender scope and verified GLPI requester.
lifecycle: An employee opts in on ticket confirmation or through the notification settings and can withdraw through WhatsApp. Withdrawal clears the delivery address. Re-enabling issues a new grant that cannot revive jobs under the previous grant.

columns.Meaning: Stable hash binding the Meta business number and the sender scope.
Verified GLPI requester who opted in.
Unique consent epoch bound to eligible ticket watches and queued ticket updates.
Validated WhatsApp address for opted-in ticket updates.
columns.Null meaning: The employee withdrew the grant and the address was cleared.

columns.Meaning: Time at which WhatsApp recorded the active or most recently withdrawn grant.
Time at which the employee withdrew the grant.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((glpi_user_id > 0) AND ((revoked_at IS NULL) = (recipient IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Requires a verified positive GLPI ID and limits stored recipients to active grants.
Keeps a single latest grant per sender scope.
